# during

Allen DURING: this event's extent falls strictly within the related event's extent (both endpoints interior). Transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:contains`](gmeow-contains.md). Distinct from [`gmeow:subEventOf`](gmeow-subEventOf.md) (mereological part-of) and [`gmeow:containedInPlace`](gmeow-containedInPlace.md) (spatial).
